title: Binary value modulo four
statement: Let $w$ be a bit string whose binary value is odd. Its value is congruent to $3$ modulo $4$ if and only if the second bit of $w$ is $1$, where a missing second bit is treated as $0$.
hypotheses_covered: The binary value of $w$ is odd
